title: long-term effects of social media on adolescent mental health
summary: In unadjusted models, social media use at age 15/16 was positively associated with anxiety and depression five years later, but these associations were no longer significant after adjusting for confounders.

sources.title: Long-term consequences of adolescent social media use on mental health in young adulthood
